messages:
Sana: Quick sync  we need to finalize Pinecone + Snowflake Delta Share connector certification plan for the marketplace listing. Focus: CI gating, schema mapping, and Delta Share ACLs.
Diego: Is Pinecone on the preferred vector list? Last I checked they asked for a small SDK patch.
Priya: Yes Pinecone confirmed SDK patch v0.9.2 for our connector. They sent a compatibility note. Ill add to the repo.
Sana: Great. Key asks: 1) automated CI that runs a Delta Share ingest -> transform -> upsert into Pinecone index, 2) schema mapping doc for customers, 3) marketplace metadata (preview, demo creds).
Jules: On the infra side I need a reproducible sample dataset and a reproducible pipeline (Git branch) we can use in CI. Suggest using the retail-sample delta table with 10k rows.
Priya: I'll export a masked sample dataset and push to the partner-test bucket. ETA 24h.
Diego: QA Bot, can you run a dry-run matrix for connector compatibility across Snowflake 6.x and 7.x?
QA Bot: Scheduled job created: connectors/ci/delta-share-pinecone-matrix. Runs: Snowflake-6.8,Snowflake-7.1; Pinecone-client-0.9.2; Redwood-connector-2.4. Status: queued.
Sana: CI snippet we want in the repo README so partners can reproduce:
```
# CI pipeline (GitHub Actions)
name: delta-share-pinecone-ci
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
      - name: Run integration tests
        run: python tests/integration/run_delta_to_pinecone.py --sample-bucket ${{ secrets.SAMPLE_BUCKET }}
```
Priya: Also we need to capture ACL flows for Delta Share to make sure customers can restrict columns before vectorization. Legal wanted a short diagram in the listing.
Diego: Marketplace metadata decisions: combined listing (Redwood + Pinecone + connector) vs separate listings. Combined gives easier discovery but requires partner revenue share signoff. Thoughts?
Jules: Ops prefers separate listing with a "recommended integration" badge to avoid revenue-share complexity. Partner PMs may push for combined.
Sana: Action items: Priya = sample dataset + schema mapping doc (due +1 day), Diego = revenue share ask & partner PM ping (due +3 days), Jules = CI workflow and infra soak plan (due +2 days).
Partner Bot: Action item created: "delta-pinecone-cert" assigned to Priya, due 2025-01-11T23:59:00Z.
Priya: Noted. I'll include a short rollback for the listing (unpublish + feature-flag).
Diego: Also flagging hardware partner DGX for accelerated quantization tests. We need a short test matrix for GPU perf and any firmware minimums.
Jules: I can schedule a 2-day soak on the DGX staging pool after CI green. Prefab image uses CUDA 12 and our optimized kernels.
Sana: Embargo/announce: marketing wants a 2-week lead. Proposed go-live date 2025-01-28. Embargo lock by 2025-01-14. Any objections?
Diego: No objections, but legal signoff on marketing copy needed by 2025-01-13.
Priya: Will add SSO & token scoping tests with Snowflake service principal to the CI.
Jules: QA Bot: please ensure we capture failure logs for index mismatch and column-missing errors.
QA Bot: Will enable verbose logs and upload artifacts to the action run.
Sana: Ok team, I'll pick this up into the triage doc and loop in partner PMs at EOD tomorrow once sample dataset is available. Short follow-up meeting Thurs 10am PT.
Diego: Thanks all.
Sana: End of thread.
